## `pygeovision.models.change_detection.bit`

BIT — Bitemporal Image Transformer for change detection.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ResNetBackbone` | class | Wraps a torchvision ResNet trunk, exposing forward() that runs stem -> layer1 -> layer2 -> [layer3] -> [layer4] and stops at the configured stage, matching… |
| `BITModel` | class | Real BIT nn.Module builder. See module docstring for architecture. |
| `build_bit` | function | Factory used by the model registry — `get_model('bit-r50', ...)`. |
| `BITChangeDetector` | class | Real geospatial wrapper around BIT — reads two co-registered GeoTIFFs, runs real inference, writes a georeferenced change mask. |
